title: U-Shaped and Gaussian EEG Power Profiles: Mathematical and Neurobiological Underpinnings
content: Critical insights into brain function and dysfunction are provided by the electroencephalographic (EEG) power spectrum. Often mentioned are two main trends: bell-shaped (Gaussian) profiles usually seen in healthy development and U-shaped (parabolic) profiles more often noted in neurodevelopmental diseases like Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). This research investigates the mathematical foundations supporting these profiles and looks at the neurobiological mechanisms producing such spectral distributions, hence stressing their clinical relevance for diagnosis and intervention in ASD.
